scope: Skill routing from the listed names and descriptions only. A judge sees the listing and one request, and names the single skill it would load, or none. No skill bodies, code or tools.
metric: A case passes when the chosen skill is in `accept`; an empty `accept` means no skill from these plugins should load. Report positives, near misses and negatives separately, and compare the baseline and trimmed descriptions under identical conditions.
critical: A negative that loads a skill, or a near miss that loads a skill outside `accept`, counts against precision; a positive with no skill counts against recall.
